name: @coderpradp/ng-image-slider
description: Angular Image slider with lightbox. An Angular responsive image slider with lightbox popup. Also support youtube url, image base64 string and mp4 video urls and base64 string.

scripts.build: ng build ng-image-slider --configuration production && cp README.md CHANGELOG.md dist/@coderpradp/ng-image-slider/
scripts.build:docs: rm -rf docs && ng build imageg-slider --configuration production --base-href /ng-image-slider/ --output-path docs && mv docs/browser/* docs/ && rmdir docs/browser && touch docs/.nojekyll
